SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. 4152）
Special Branch S.) L. Station,
REPORT
Date October 15, 1932.

Subject (in full) Reference advertisement on attached translation
Marked 'A' - Prize Tickets for cigarette smokers

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Jno Robertson, Supt.

The Shanghai Tai Ho Tobacco Company, 233 Kiukiang
Road are a firm of long standing. They are better known
to the British American Tobacco Company (China), for whom
they act as local sales agents, as "Wing Tai Vo & Co.".
Acting in the capacity of distributors they are
called upon to undertake the publicity side of the business
and in this connection are offering prizes to the consumers
of "May Blossom" cigarettes, under the following conditions.
A numbered ticket is presented to any person who produces
to the "Wing Tai Vo Company, 233 Kiukiang Road :-
(A) 2 empty (50 cigarettes) May Blossom containers.
(B) 5 empty (20 cigarettes) May Blossom containers.
The tickets entitle the holder to participate in a draw
for prizes to be made at the Canidrome, at a date to be
named later. The prizes will be in the form of vouchers
on the Wing On, Sincere and Sun Sun Companies and will
be divided in the following proportions :
1. One voucher of $300.
2. Two vouchers of $100.
3. Five " " $ 50.
4. Ten " " $ 25.
5. Twenty " " $ 10.
6. Fifty " " $ 5.
7. Five Hundred " " $ 1.
A sample of the tickets to be issued is flagged at 'K'.
According to the opinion of Mr. R.T. Bryan, Jr. (M.A.)
dated July 15th, 1929 and September 18, 1930, this project
does not constitute a lottery under Chinese or English Law,
inasmuch as the promotors are not receiving a percentage

主题（全称）：参考附件中标注为“A”的译文——香烟吸烟者的奖券

由特别调查员 Golder 制作，经警司 Jno Robertson 转呈。

上海大和烟草公司（Shanghai Tai Ho Tobacco Company），位于九江路233号，是一家历史悠久的商号。他们作为英美烟草公司（中国）的本地销售代理，更为人熟知的名称是“永泰和商行”（Wing Tai Vo & Co.）。作为分销商，他们负责承担业务的宣传推广工作，并据此向“五月花”（May Blossom）香烟的消费者提供奖品，条件如下。
任何人士向“永泰和商行”，九江路233号，出示以下物品，即可获得一张编号奖券：
(A) 2个空的“五月花”香烟听装容器（每听50支）。
(B) 5个空的“五月花”香烟盒装容器（每盒20支）。
持券人有权参加在跑狗场（Canidrome）举行的抽奖活动，具体日期待定。奖品将以永安、先施和新新公司的礼券形式发放，比例分配如下：
1. 面值300元的礼券一张。
2. 面值100元的礼券两张。
3. 面值50元的礼券五张。
4. 面值25元的礼券十张。
5. 面值10元的礼券二十张。
6. 面值5元的礼券五十张。
7. 面值1元的礼券五百张。
拟发行的奖券样本标记为“K”。
根据 R.T. Bryan, Jr. 先生（文学硕士）于1929年7月15日和1930年9月18日提出的意见，该项目不构成中国法律或英国法律意义上的彩票，因为推广方并未从中收取百分比

October 12, 1932. Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

Sin Wen Pao

COLLABORATION SERVICE FOR POSTAL COMRADES WHO FELL DURING
SINO JAPANESE HOSTILITIES.

The All-China General Postal Workers Union
has decided to hold a service on October 16 in the
premises of the Young Men's Lecturing Group, Small
East Gate, commemorating the memory of those comrades
who sacrificed their lives during the anti-Japanese
movement throughout the country.

Sin Wen Pao

RED PILL MAGNATE FORFEITS $8,000 BAIL BY NON APPEARANCE
AT COURT.

Chien Tsao-bei (錢造培), nick-named Siau
Shantung (小山東), the Red Pill magnate, who was
arrested by the French Police together with five of
his assistants and released on a cash security of $8,000,
failed to effect an appearance on remand before the
Second Shanghai Special District Court yesterday. An
order for his arrest has been issued.

China Times

QUOTATION OF PRICES OF RICE TO BE PROHIBITED TO AVOID
HOARDING.

The local Citizens Federation yesterday
petitioned the Nanking Ministry of Industry and the
Bureau of Social Affairs of the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai to prohibit the local Cereal Exchange from
quoting the prices of rice, evidently the Saigon
product, in order to avoid hoarding of rice by the
merchants who will monopolize the food supply of the
people.

PRIZE TICKETS FOR CIGARETTE SMOKERS.

The Shanghai Tai Ho Tobacco Company publishes
the following advertisement in the Eastern Times:-
In order to increase our patrons' interest in
our products, our Company, which has been distributing
prize tickets to all local cigarette consumers since
September 5, 1932 now requests them to present two empty
tins, or five empty cases of twenty cigarette-size or ten
empty cases of ten cigarette-size, of "May Blossom"
cigarettes which will be exchanged for one of our prize
tickets. The drawing of these tickets will take place once
a month for three successive months. The prizes consist
of our cigarettes or gift cheques payable in goods at the
Wing On, Sincere and Sun Sun Companies.
These prizes rank from $1.00 to $300.00. The
prize winners are requested to present their coupons at
our Company office at No.233, Kiukiang Road.

1932年10月12日。晨间译文

杂项

《新闻报》

为在中日敌对行动中牺牲的邮政同仁举行追悼会。

中华全国邮政总工会决定于10月16日在小东门青年演讲团址举行仪式，纪念在全国抗日运动中牺牲生命的同仁。

《新闻报》

“红丸大王”因未出庭被没收8,000美元保释金。

绰号“小山东”的红丸大亨钱造培（Chien Tsao-bei），此前与五名助手一同被法租界巡捕房逮捕，并以8,000美元现金担保获释，昨日未能在上海第二特区地方法院续审时出庭。已签发对其逮捕令。

《字林西报》

禁止大米报价以防囤积。

本地市民联合会昨日向南京实业部和上海特别市社会局请愿，要求禁止本地粮食交易所对大米（显然是西贡产品）进行报价，以避免商人垄断民众粮食供应而囤积大米。

香烟吸烟者的奖券。

上海大和烟草公司在《时事新报》上刊登如下广告：
为提高顾客对我们产品的兴趣，本公司自1932年9月5日起向本地所有香烟消费者分发奖券，现请消费者出示两听空罐，或五盒空盒（每盒20支装）或十盒空盒（每盒10支装）的“五月花”香烟，以兑换一张奖券。抽奖活动将在连续三个月内每月举行一次。奖品包括本公司香烟或可在永安、先施和新新公司兑换商品的礼券。
这些奖品价值从1.00美元到300.00美元不等。中奖者请持券至本公司办公室领取，地址：九江路233号。
